transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I'm here because I have an intense, overwhelming fear of dogs. It has been a really severe problem for me for about two years and two months now.
Did this fear start after a traumatic event involving a dog, like being attacked or seriously threatened? If so, do you also have unwanted memories, nightmares, or feel on edge because of it?
No, I don't recall any specific traumatic event like a dog attack that triggered this fear. I also don't experience nightmares, unwanted memories, or feel constantly on edge because of it.
Do you go out of your way to avoid dogs or places where dogs might be, and does this fear interfere with your daily life?

Yes, I go completely out of my way to avoid any place a dog might be, like parks or even certain sidewalks. This avoidance has severely restricted my life, making it really hard to visit friends or even walk to work. It's constantly interfering with my daily routine.
When you see a dog or even think you might encounter one, do you feel an immediate surge of fear or panic that you know is stronger than the actual danger?

Yes, absolutely. Even just thinking about the possibility of running into a dog makes me extremely anxious. If I actually see one, I instantly experience an overwhelming, immediate surge of panic and fear.
